security_assumptions: Header-chain validity only: no transaction, script or UTXO validation, and no best-chain selection (compare chainwork with a node).
The future-time rule is not enforced (needs a wall clock).
Soundness of nova-snark 0.76.0 (Pallas/Vesta IPA, Spartan) and SHA-256; not post-quantum.
Verifier keys are deterministic candidates pinned by SHA-256, not audited releases.
The native rules are a differential reference checked against Bitcoin Core; agreement with Core is not a proof of circuit soundness.
Continuation payloads contain witness material and are not zero knowledge.
Unspentness in SPV receipts is Bitcoin Core's view at lookup, not proven.
